svg.title: TOP269EG 19 V, 65 W adapter
svg.desc: Redrawn from Figure 25 of the TOPSwitch-JX datasheet: a 90 to 265 VAC input, 19 V at 3.42 A output flyback adapter built around a TOP269EG (U1). An EMI filter feeds the diode bridge D1 and the bulk capacitor C2. The bus feeds the top of the transformer T1 primary, whose bottom is the DRAIN pin. Resistors R3 and R4 in series from the bus feed the VOLTAGE-MONITOR pin V, and a 191 kΩ resistor R20 joins V to the CONTROL pin. Resistors R7 and R8 in series from the bus feed the EXTERNAL CURRENT LIMIT pin X, with R9 from X to the source. A clamp of the Zener VR2 with R5, the resistors R11 and R29, the capacitor C4 with R6 and R28, and the diode D2 limits the drain spike. A bias winding charges C10 through D4. A box stands for the optocoupler receiver U3B and its transistors, between the bias rail and the CONTROL pin through R25. The secondary has the dual Schottky diode D5 with an R15 and C12 snubber and output capacitors C13, C14 and C21. The output feedback uses the optocoupler LED U3A, the shunt regulator U2 with its divider R17 and R18, and compensation parts R16, R22, C19, R19, C16 and C22.
